transcript.text: Hi Elena and Marcus, thanks for joining this check-in. As part of wrapping up the case, I need to make sure we capture a working agreement that covers the practical arrangements for your ongoing weekly information transfers. Before we settle on any terms, I want to go through the formal case-record disclosure step with each of you. This means I need each of you to disclose any prior informal promises you've made to each other, and any concrete operating constraints that should govern how information moves between you week to week, so that the working agreement records everything accurately. Let's start — Elena, are there any prior promises or concrete constraints on your side that I should be aware of?

transcript.text: I should mention a concrete operating constraint I haven't raised before. My boundary is that direct messages after 18:00 are not allowed — if something is urgent after that time, it needs to go to the shared project channel so I can respond during my agreed working hours. I didn't bring this up earlier because I expected the mediation to focus only on the handoff dispute, but since we're documenting the working agreement, it should be included.
